change: Authenticate an existing regular repository amendment with no symlink components, resolve its canonical repository identity, and persist authenticated.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix().
concrete_defect: An absolute repository --amendment is authenticated but persisted as an absolute claims_plan; the current reconciler rejects that noncanonical relative input path.
control_method: AST-extract only the path-authentication helper into a standalone namespace; no wrapper main/import, preparation, test/build/model/channel, or qualification invocation.

development_controls.input: redundant dot path to same input
internal parent traversal to same input

input_policy: Relative CLI paths are interpreted against the process working directory. Absolute paths are also accepted if they resolve to a regular input inside ROOT. Missing files, directories, symlink components, and escaped resolved paths are rejected before identity collection/freeze.
